title: Expose the Admin payment journal and correction controls
verify: FT-006-AC-010 / REQ-012 / REQ-013 / REQ-014 / REQ-015: the protected own-center Admin journal lists each recorded or cancelled Payment once with server-resolved class/student, exact amount, factual date, status, allocations, current balance/advance, and audit history.

The journal's edit and cancel actions require explicit confirmation and invoke only the existing Financial Ledger editPayment and cancelPayment commands; after success the authoritative allocation, balance, status, and before/after audit are reloaded.
The journal contains no payment-creation form. Anonymous, Teacher, Student, Parent, wrong-center, forged class/student, and forged payment requests are rejected before mutation.
Disposable Playwright proof uses the project-owned temporary database/server and removes only its exact temporary state.
evidence_required: FT-006-AC-010 / REQ-012 / REQ-013 / REQ-014 / REQ-015 RED: the journal omits or duplicates a payment, exposes an out-of-scope record, edits/cancels without explicit Admin confirmation, fails to show refreshed allocation/balance/audit, or introduces a second creation path; GREEN: own-center Admin can inspect every in-scope payment once, edit or cancel only with confirmation, and see deterministic recalculation plus audit while all denials leave state unchanged; artifact: .tasks/TASK-100-T3-FT-006-W33/ and .protocols/TASK-100-T3-FT-006-W33/.
purpose: Close the missing Admin payment-journal read and correction user outcome over the existing Financial Ledger edit, cancel, allocation, replay, and audit commands.
success_outcome: An own-center Admin can inspect a complete payment journal and safely edit or cancel a payment with explicit confirmation, then see authoritative allocation, balance, status, and audit results.
anti_goals: Do not add a payment-creation form to the journal; creation remains in the existing Lesson Context flow.
Do not reimplement allocation, replay, balance, or audit logic in the route.
Do not grant Teacher edit/cancel authority or trust client-provided center, class, student, or payment scope.
Do not let the route or UI write financial tables directly.
constraints: The Admin page composes server-resolved own-center class/student pairs and the named Financial Ledger projections; it owns no financial facts.
Edit and cancel actions carry the payment identity, validated change, and explicit confirmation into existing commands; successful actions reload authoritative state.
The journal must represent recorded and cancelled payments once, including exact decimal-safe values and audit-relevant before/after information.
Disposable browser proof uses tmp/ and the project runner; it must never use study-calendar.db.
invariants: Only an Admin scoped to the payment's center can edit or cancel it.
Denied reads and commands leave Payment, Allocation, Charge, Balance, and Audit state unchanged.
Journal correction results come from Financial Ledger deterministic replay and audit, not UI arithmetic.
Payment creation remains the existing Lesson Context behavior and is not duplicated here.
verification_targets: FT-006-AC-010: route/action tests and browser proof cover one-time journal listing, exact amount/factual date/status, allocations, balance/advance, audit, Admin edit, Admin cancel, explicit confirmation, and post-command reload.
Privacy and authorization: prove anonymous, non-Admin, wrong-center, forged class/student, and forged payment reads/mutations fail before mutation, with no client-trusted scope.
Ownership: source review confirms the Admin route calls Financial Ledger commands/queries and contains no direct financial persistence or duplicate payment creation logic.

stop_conditions: Stop if the journal needs a new financial command or persistence owner rather than the accepted projection and existing edit/cancel commands; route the contract change to spec-redesign before implementation.
Stop if any action would trust client-provided scope, expose another center/student, or bypass the Financial Ledger boundary.
Stop if disposable E2E requires study-calendar.db, an existing server, or reset of unrelated state.
